turns.content: yaar ajeeb sa scene ho gaya hai. Manav — mera school ka dost, chhe saal se saath reh rahe hain — woh shift ho raha hai, apni fiancée ke saath rahega. Baat theek hai, hona hi tha shaadi se pehle. Par mujhe yeh building ke WhatsApp group se pata chala. Owner ne pucha "flat mein naya banda kab aa raha hai?" Main wahin baitha tha. Mujhe usne bataya hi nahi tha ab tak.

Yaar, ye toh dil pe lagta hai. Baat flat chhodne ki nahi hai — baat ye hai ki chhe saal ka dost tujhe WhatsApp group se pata chale? Woh bhi owner ki message se? Jab tu wahin baitha tha?

Ye jo feeling hai na — "main itna important nahi hoon uske liye ki khud bataye" — ye bahut real hai. Aur isko casually "koi baat nahi" mein dismiss mat kar apne aap ko. Karta hai hurt.

Do cheezein ho sakti hain:

**Ek** — ho sakta hai Manav ko laga "abhi pakka nahi hua, jab confirm ho tab bolunga" — log aise soch ke baat taalte hain, sochte hain kya bataun abhi. Par bhai, chhe saal ka dost hai, "yaar dekh plan ban raha hai" bolna itna mushkil nahi tha.

**Doosri** — thoda uncomfortable sach — shaadi hone waali hai, fiancée aa rahi hai, uski duniya shift ho rahi hai. Bohot logon ki priority list mein ye hota hai ki pehle naya chapter settle karo, phir baaton mein aayega. Selfish nahi hota ye, par tere liye ekdam valid hai ki tu sidelined feel kare.

Bas ek kaam kar — ek baar seedha bol de usko, casually but honestly: *"Bhai mujhe group se pata chala, thoda ajeeb laga."* Jhagda nahi, complaint nahi — bas apni feeling rakh de. Uska reaction tujhe bahut kuch bata dega ki ye dosti kahan khadi hai.

phir raat ko usne casually bola "haan yaar batane hi wala tha, busy chal raha tha." Busy? Chhe saal ek kamre mein rahe hain, uski har cheez mujhe sabse pehle pata hoti thi. Uska rishta pakka hua toh main mithai leke uske ghar gaya tha. Aur ab main building group se pata karta hoon ki mera ghar khali ho raha hai.

Yaar... ye jo tune likha na — *"uski har cheez mujhe sabse pehle pata hoti thi"* — ye line mein poora answer hai. Tune apni jagah clear rakhi thi us friendship mein. Aur ab woh jagah empty ho gayi hai — usne bhi nahi rakhi, tune bhi nahi chhini.

"Bataane hi wala tha" — ye sabse thanda excuse hota hai. Bataane hi wala tha toh bataa na bhai? Ek text, ek call, chai pe baith ke — chhe saal ke liye itna toh banta hai. Lekin usne wo effort nahi daala. Aur ye "busy" — yaar wo mithai leke ghar aane waala dost busy ke excuse deserve karta tha?

Aur ye jo sach hai na sabse mushkil waala — tu abhi hurt isliye nahi hai kyunki woh jaa raha hai. Tu hurt hai kyunki tujhe **importance** nahi mili. Tujhe wo moment nahi mila jahan woh baith ke bole *"yaar, dekh main shift ho raha hoon, thoda adjust karna padega."* Tu deserve karta tha wo conversation.

Ab yahan se ek cheez samajh — tune kuch galat nahi kiya. Tera dosti nibhaana, mithai leke jaana, pehle pata hona — ye sab teri quality hai, ye kamzori nahi hai. Par ye bhi sach hai ki log badalte hain, unki priorities shift hoti hain, aur kabhi kabhi humein wo closure nahi milta jo hum chahte hain.

Ab tera kaam hai — apni feeling usko bol de ek baar, seedha. Naraazgi nahi, just honest baat. Uske baad jo reaction aaye, woh tujhe raasta dikhayega.

It's fine. I have made my peace with it. People get married, people move on, priorities change. This is how life works. I will figure out the flat situation. It is not a big deal and I would prefer not to make it one.

Sahi hai. Maana tune.

Par ek baat bolunga — agar ye waala "fine" sach mein fine hai, toh bahut achha hai. Tu mature hai, samajhdaar hai.

Lekin agar ye woh waala "fine" hai jahan andar kuch daba ke rakh diya hai kyunki *"kya hi bolunga, kya hi fark padega"* — toh bhai, woh bhi theek hai. Usko bhi time do. Dost kho dena chhoti cheez nahi hai, chahe koi maane ya na maane.

Bas itna yaad rakh — flat ka figure out tu kar lega. Tera nature hi hai handle karna. Par agar kabhi lage ki baat karni hai, main yahan hoon. Koi formality nahi, koi judgement nahi. 🤝

soch raha hoon usko bas itna reply kar doon — "Congratulations. I will start looking for a new flatmate from next week." Simple, clean, no drama. Usko bhi clear ho jayega aur mujhe bhi baar baar explain nahi karna padega. Theek hai na yeh?

Theek toh hai. Clean hai, clear hai, koi tamasha nahi.

Par ek cheez notice kar — ye message **practical** lagta hai surface pe, lekin asli mein ye ek boundary hai. Manav samajh jaayega. "Congratulations" mein wo warmth nahi hai jo chhe saal ke dost ke liye hoti. "I will start looking" mein wo distance hai jo bol raha hai — ab ye flatmate arrangement hai, woh wali dosti nahi.

Agar tu sach mein ye feel karta hai — toh bhej de. Sahi hai.

Par agar ye message isliye hai kyunki tu hurt hai aur usko dikhana nahi chahta — toh ek second ruk. Kabhi kabhi "no drama" bolke hum apne aap ko bolne ka mauka cheen lete hain. Aur woh baad mein zyada khata hai.

Tujhe pata hai kaunsa wala case hai. Apne hisaab se kar. Koi galat nahi hai yahan.
